story.para1: M TAI grew out of the real-life experiences of its founder, Victory Kilindo—as a business owner, a customer, and a tradesman purchasing materials for his work. These experiences revealed everyday challenges in buying, selling, and managing business activities.
story.para2: His journey into graphic design and computing helped him see how those challenges could be addressed through practical digital tools. He began shaping an idea: bringing businesses, customers, and transporters together within one connected platform.
story.para3: In 2025, Victory founded M TAI. A product of Big Brain Company Limited, M TAI is built around a clear purpose: to simplify commerce, support business growth, and serve the everyday needs of businesses and customers across Tanzania and Africa.

ourStory.title: M TAI — Merchant Trading App International
ourStory.subtitle: A Vision Shaped by Experience, Faith and Purpose

sections.title: From Everyday Challenges to a Bigger Vision
sections.text: M TAI began with the lived experiences of its founder, Victory Kilindo. While running a stationery business, he faced the daily pressures of purchasing goods, managing inventory, recording sales and serving customers. Later, working as a technician, he experienced the buyer's side of trade: searching for materials, travelling between suppliers and arranging costly transportation. These experiences showed him that buyers and sellers were often struggling with different parts of the same problem.

sections.title: An Unexpected Path into Technology
sections.text: A move into graphic design and computing changed how Victory saw those challenges. He had not attended a coding or programming school, but he began to recognize that many everyday trading difficulties could be translated into organized digital processes. He documented his ideas and envisioned one connected environment bringing together customers, businesses, suppliers and transporters. What began as practical observations became a plan for a technology platform.

sections.title: Faith at the Heart of the Journey
sections.text: Victory sees this journey as a blessing from God. As a follower of Jesus Christ, he believes that God has given him creativity, insight and the determination to pursue a calling beyond his formal training. Prayer and faith have helped sustain him through uncertainty, financial limitations and the demanding process of turning an idea into reality. For him, M TAI is not merely a business achievement; it is an opportunity to put God-given abilities to work in service of others.

sections.title: Turning the Vision into Reality
sections.text: Early conversations with developers confirmed the idea could be built, although the cost was a major obstacle. Victory continued refining the concept and joined forces with engineer Raphael Ngombale and investment partner Alfaxa Boniface. Under Big Brain Company Limited, the project evolved from TradeVK into M TAI — Merchant Trading App International.

sections.title: Built to Make Trade Easier
sections.text: M TAI aims to reduce the friction that slows commerce: difficulty finding goods, fragmented purchasing, manual business processes and inefficient delivery arrangements. Its vision is to help businesses operate more effectively, customers shop more conveniently, and transporters connect with opportunities. The platform is still growing, but its purpose remains clear: to turn real-life challenges into practical solutions that can serve people across communities and, ultimately, across borders.

ourStory.closing: M TAI — More Than a Marketplace. Built for Your Success.
